name: Lick Roll
detailed_description:
🟣 About This Game

This world is sugar-sweet... but the journey is anything but easy.

Lick & Roll is a physics-based puzzle adventure game where you guide a colorful candy ball along whimsical floating tracks. Twist, bounce, and roll through mouthwatering traps in a charming macaron-inspired world. Every level is a bite-sized adventure—deceptively cute, yet filled with clever tricks and tricky turns.

Inspired by classic marble-rolling games and wrapped in a delightful dessert aesthetic, this is a relaxing yet exhilarating experience. Master your movement, solve tasty little puzzles, and balance calm with chaos in dozens of handcrafted levels.

Roll smooth. Think sharp. Taste sweet victory.

🧁 Key Features

🍬 A Sugary World of Delight
Every level is like a handcrafted pastry box, with macaron-inspired visuals and delicious detail. Sweet, colorful, and slightly dangerous.

🌀 Satisfying, Physics-Driven Rolling
Feel the weight and bounce of your candy ball as it responds to gravity, slopes, and your precise control. It’s not just about speed—it’s about finesse.

🧠 Clever Puzzle-Level Design
Each stage introduces new mechanics and environmental hazards. Whether it's moving platforms, sticky traps, or twisted paths—you’ll need brains and reflexes to roll through.

🎯 Chill or Challenge—You Choose
Play casually to relax, or aim for perfect runs and top ratings. Easy to pick up, hard to master.

🎧 Soothing Sounds for Sweet Moments
Relaxing music and tactile audio feedback create a calm and rewarding gameplay rhythm.

🛝 Who Is This Game For?

  • Fans of marble games like Super Monkey Ball, Marble It Up, or Marble Madness

  • Puzzle lovers who enjoy charming visuals with a twist of challenge

  • Casual players looking for a cozy but skillful game

  • Completionists who love the sweet satisfaction of perfect runs

🛒 Add to Your Wishlist!

Can you roll through every dessert-themed stage and conquer each candy trap?
Add Lick & Roll to your wishlist now, and get ready to roll into a sugar-coated adventure like no other!
